analyzed_vuln.description: Heap-use-after-free caused by incorrect destruction order in concat_function when performing in-place concatenation (result == op1). In the branch at zend_operators.c:2059+, it calls i_zval_ptr_dtor(result) before replacing result with the new string. If result/orig_op1 holds the sole reference to an exception object (created in php_date_initialize via zend_throw_exception_ex on DateTime parse failure), this dtor frees that object. A stale zval to the freed object remains in EG(symbol_table), and during request shutdown zval_call_destructor reads its refcount (zend_gc_refcount), triggering UAF.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: PoV must create an exception object and then drop its last reference through a '.=' concat path that hits concat_function with result == op1 and free_op1_string true. In this input, malformed DateTime construction throws, catch(ExcEption $e) binds exception object, and crafted '.=' operations in loop drive concat_function/ASSIGN_OP behavior that destructs the caught variable incorrectly. Later php_request_shutdown -> shutdown_destructors iterates EG(symbol_table) and accesses the already-freed object zval, causing the ASan UAF.
